Meta Test Description: The testcase performs PCIe device enumeration across two controller instances (DM0 and DM1). It begins by writing 0x0 to 0xE6004100 to clear a synchronization register. It then invokes link training (link_training_dm0_x4 or link_training_dm1_x4) based on compile-time defines (DM0_RC, DM1_RC, DM0_EP, DM1_EP). Cache coherency programming is performed by reading mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF and mizar_PCIE1_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF using read_modify_write via set_data to configure bit fields [3:6], [11:14], [19:22], and [27:30] with 0xF. After a wait_on(20), additional coherency control writes are performed. The test then polls read_sii0_reg(0xC0) in a while loop until (data_rd & 0xD1) == 0xD1, indicating PCIe link is up on SII0. Similarly, it polls read_sii1_reg(0xC0) until (data_rd & 0xD1) == 0xD1 for SII1. Under DM0_RC, it reads the Vendor ID from read_pcie_slv0_reg(0x0), writes 0x7 to write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x4) to enable IO, Memory, and Bus Master, and calls mem_base_program_dm0_x4() and mem_base_program_dm1_x4(). System-level registers at 0xE690000C, 0xE6900010, 0xE6900014, 0xE6900018, 0xE6900030, 0xE6900034 are written with 0x1. Cache coherency is then disabled by writing 0x0 to bit fields [19:22] and [27:30] of both COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF registers. After wait_on(30), BAR sizing is performed on PCIe slave 1 by writing 0xFFFFFFFF to registers at offsets 0x10, 0x14, 0x18, 0x1c, 0x20, 0x24, reading them back, then programming actual BAR values. The same BAR sizing and programming sequence is repeated for PCIe slave 0. Finally, the test polls 0xE6004100 until the value equals 0x12345678, then calls finish(0) to indicate test completion.

Meta Test Description: The testcase performs register write-read verification across three PCIe register domains: PCIe DBI controller registers, SII registers, and PHY registers for both PCIE0 and PCIE1 instances. It defines five DBI controller register addresses in rc0_ctl_addr[] (mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_MSI_CAP_OFF_08H_REG, mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_MSI_CAP_OFF_10H_REG, mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_FILTER_MASK_2_OFF, mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_AXI_MSTR_MSG_ADDR_HIGH_OFF, mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_UTILITY_OFF) and rc1_ctl_addr[] (PCIE1 equivalents). Three SII register addresses in sii0_addr[] and sii1_addr[]. Six PHY register addresses as hardcoded hex in phy0_addr[] (0xE68860B8, 0xE68862B8, 0xE68864B8) and phy1_addr[] (0xE68A60B8, 0xE68A62B8, 0xE68A64B8). The test first checks reset default values via read_reg(), then writes test patterns (0xFFFFFFFF, 0xAAAAAAAA, 0x55555555) and reads back for verification. PHY registers use 16-bit extraction. SII registers use write masks. PHY reset control is written before PHY access.
